name: capture-team
description: Finds organizations and named groups worth pursuing, enriches and classifies inbound leads against your ICP, and turns raw signals into client-ready intelligence briefs. 3 roles: Chet (Cluster Discovery), Kipp (CRM Intake), Ben (Signal Delivery).

interface.shortDescription: Find capacity-gap groups, enrich inbound records, and deliver client-ready briefs
interface.longDescription: An AI Team of three specialized Digital Employees: Chet finds named, bounded groups worth pursuing; Kipp enriches and classifies inbound org and contact records against your ICP; Ben turns the resulting signals into client-ready intelligence briefs. Bring your own enrichment tool, ICP criteria, and CRM database. Want to build, customize, and manage AI Teams like this one for your own workflows? That's what THINK School on Skool teaches -- see skool.com/thinkschool/about.
defaultPrompt: Find named groups or clusters that share a capacity gap we can fill
Enrich and classify this list of inbound leads against our ICP
Turn this week's signals into a client-ready intelligence brief
